placement.address: Beneath the former Sixth Street Viaduct · Santa Fe / Mesquit
placement.reason: Scene comparisons identify the lower roadway beneath the original viaduct near Santa Fe and Mesquit. The marker follows MovieMaps’ under-bridge scene-area point; the exact materialization footprint is not surveyed. The old bridge was demolished in 2016 and its replacement opened in 2022. The story establishes Los Angeles without a conflicting street address.

audit.verification: MovieMaps publishes llat34.038441094 / llng-118.229430898 for Mesquit Street under East 6th. Film Oblivion names lower East 6th / Santa Fe and documents the replacement; James Cameron Online matches the old pillars, arch and buildings in the sequence. This is a scene-area proxy, not a claim that a 1991 pillar survives. Nearby To Live and Die in L.A. events remain separate story events, not a shared named venue.
audit.spoilers: AFI confirms the officer dies. The ordinary arrival entry retains only the T-1000 as a character. The separate death entry protects the victim label, full outcome clause and screen image. The site photograph and street address remain readable.
audit.victimName: The comparison guide calls the officer Austin; the catalog uses the primary AFI synopsis’s generic patrol officer rather than asserting a name absent from that synopsis.
